generators.carrier: sympy Matrix over exact algebraic numbers; Kronecker product of a 2x2 and a 3x3 matrix

relations.statement: For the product triple I_6, F_2 tensor F_3 / sqrt 6, and A_2 tensor C_2, each pair of bases is unbiased, meaning every entry of U^* V has modulus 1/sqrt 6.
relations.hypotheses: A_2 tensor C_2 is row-phase equivalent to F_2 tensor F_3, as stated in the target; exact check recorded at MUB6-DERIV-063.

lemmas.statement: The affine family through F_2 tensor F_3 contains a third basis unbiased to both I_6 and F_2 tensor F_3 / sqrt 6, namely A_2 tensor C_2, so the refuted claim fails.

near_misses.claim: No affine family through F_2 tensor F_3 contains a third basis unbiased to both I_6 and F_2 tensor F_3 / sqrt 6.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: The product triple I_6, F_2 tensor F_3 / sqrt 6, A_2 tensor C_2 is pairwise unbiased per the exact SymPy check at MUB6-DERIV-063.

open_obligations: Definitions of A_2 and C_2 are not in the sources, so they cannot be formalized.
The exact check at MUB6-DERIV-063 is not available here and must be re-run by the host.
The row-phase equivalence of A_2 tensor C_2 with F_2 tensor F_3 is not formalized.
Affine-fiber stratification of CHM(6) is not formalized.
Lean statements are placeholders and nothing is proved.
No existing declaration is cited for the unbiasedness relation.
